_comment: THE FIFTH VERB, and the only recipe of its type today (#248).
Blaze powder cannot be melted - it is already fire - so the honest operation is sintering:
holding a pressed compact below its melting point until the particles fuse into a solid. That
is how powder metallurgy makes rod stock, and it is a different thing from vitrifying, which
takes a solid to a glass.
What it unlocks is larger than one item. A brewing stand needs a blaze rod, so every potion in
the game sat behind this, and the fortresses in the compacted depths were the only way to one.
Time and experience are first-pass; #36 owns them.
